burrito-craft.title: Play Burrito Craft Online - Free Minecraft-Inspired Sandbox!
burrito-craft.slogan: Craft Your World in Burrito Craft!
burrito-craft.description: Dive into Burrito Craft, a sandbox adventure inspired by Minecraft 1.5.2! Explore limitless possibilities, from farming to thrilling builds. Play Burrito Craft free online now! Enjoy Burrito Craft!

HomeIframe.title: Burrito Craft™
HomeIframe.description: Experience the freedom of a sandbox world in Burrito Craft. Build, explore, and create without limits!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Burrito Craft offers a boundless sandbox world where you can be a farmer, an adventurer, or an architect. Inspired by Minecraft, realize your dreams in Burrito Craft!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Explore the blocky world and gather resources.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Craft tools and build structures to survive.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Conquer challenges alone or with friends in multiplayer.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experiment with crazy builds and bring your imagination to life.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Enjoy features up to version 1.5.2 of the original Minecraft.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Work together with others to conquer the blocky world.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Become a farmer, an adventurer, or anything you want to be.
